captions.detailed: A solid, 3D paraboloid shape featuring a perfectly flat circular top surface and a smooth, parabolic curved bottom that tapers down to a rounded point. It acts as a solid reflector dish or nose-cone-like structure, with no holes or mounting features, presenting a clean, continuous mathematical curve.
captions.instruction: Please design a parametric paraboloid module in OpenSCAD. The user should be able to adjust the height (y), the focus distance (f), a focal center offset (fc), and the radius of the focus area (rfa) to customize the curvature and base size of the dish.
captions.factory: The code generates a paraboloid by performing a 2D projection cut of a rotated 3D cylinder (representing a cone) to obtain a parabolic curve. This 2D profile is combined with a square using a union, trimmed using a difference operation with another square to clean up the rotation axis, and finally transformed into a 3D solid using rotate_extrude.
